question: True or false: if you leave out key, React falls back to using the item index.
say: True or false: if you leave out the key, React falls back to using the item index.
explanation: True. With no key, React uses the index, which can cause bugs when items are inserted, removed or reordered.
explainSay: True. React uses the index if you give no key, which is exactly why reordering can cause bugs.
